inputs.text: [excited] Kar… kar… oh… don… toh… saurus. [curious] "Charcharo," in Greek, means jagged and sharp — it's the same root that gives us the word "shark." [serious] "Odonto" means tooth. And "saurus" means lizard.
[playful] Shark… tooth… I got "shark." [hesitant] So what's it all mean stuck together?
[happily] The shark-toothed lizard. It lived in North Africa, [amazed] ninety-five million years ago.
[playful] Yes, same Africa. [confident] One hunted on land, [calm] the other in the water — they stayed out of each other's way.
